name: The Fallen Banner Way
introDiscord:
The road from Leviathan's Wake finally reaches stone.

Not bone.

Actual stone.

A drowned avenue stretches between toppled towers and faded royal
banners while statues of armored guards line the old kingdom gates.

Someone has tied a tiny ribbon around one statue's spear.

Shizuki was definitely here.

the-fallen-banner-way-approach.prompt: The Fallen Banner Way opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A Drowned Banner Guard steps from beneath a hanging royal standard.

The kingdom has been abandoned for ages.

The guard has apparently not received the memo.

right.message:
An overturned welcome booth still contains a little ceremonial coffer.

Shizuki scratched into the counter:

'Kingdom admission fee:

apparently free now.'

forward.message:
A public fountain still bubbles with clear mineral water.

Beside it is Shizuki's note:

'FIRST ROYAL FOUNTAIN!!!

I made a wish.

Glimmer says telling you the wish invalidates it.

So obviously it involved berries.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the fountain untouched.

Your health is already excellent.

Wish eligibility remains untested.

the-fallen-banner-way-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Fallen Banner Way, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
A ceremonial chalice rests inside an abandoned guard kiosk.

It contains Star Candies.

Someone wrote beneath it:

'Royal snack cup.

Source: me.'

right.message:
A Drowned Banner Guard raises its standard and blocks the street.

You are being challenged by someone whose shift ended several centuries
ago.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's first kingdom map.

Every street has a label.

'PALACE?'

'MARKET??'

'VERY NICE FOUNTAIN.'

One arrow simply says:

'GLIMMER WENT THIS WAY HELP.'

the-fallen-banner-way-threshold.prompt: Near Hall of Torn Colors, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message:
An intact guardhouse contains old restorative salts.

Shizuki added a sign:

'Royal medical supplies.

I have promoted myself to authorized personnel.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave Her Royal Medical Authorization unused.

right.message:
A fallen banner pole has pinned a guard stipend beneath the stone.

The coins are useless.

The Star Candies mixed among them are considerably more relevant.

forward.message:
One final Banner Guard plants its standard in the road.

The gesture is extremely dramatic.

Respectfully:

move.

boss-antechamber.name: Hall of Torn Colors
boss-antechamber.prompt: The Hall of Torn Colors opens beyond the avenue.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Hall of Torn Colors opens beyond the avenue.

Hundreds of old standards hang from the ceiling, their faded colors
moving together in the current.

Every remaining Banner Guard steps aside.

At the far end, something lifts a standard larger than any of the others.

Use /yes to enter the Hall or /no to postpone your extremely unofficial
royal visit.

bossRetreatText:
You return to the outer avenue.

The banners continue drifting behind you.

boss.revealText:
The largest standard sweeps aside.

Standard-Bearer Revenant reveals itself!

completionText:
The Revenant lowers its standard.

Beyond the Hall, the kingdom proper finally opens.

Shops.

Canals.

Gardens.

Palaces.

Shizuki's next arrow reads:

'WE ARE GOING SHOPPING.'
